features.name: oc_cites_specific_real_world_example
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment cite a specific real-world example as support?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment offers a specific, concrete real-world example (a named or identifiable actual person, event, case, place, study, statistic instance, or personal real experience) as support for its argument. Return 0 if no comment does so (generic, abstract or purely hypothetical scenarios do not count). Quoted material counts only if the commenter cites it as a supporting example. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates or reports of the outcome as evidence. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null.

h0: oc_cites_specific_real_world_example has no association with the probability of delta=1.
h1: Discussions with oc_cites_specific_real_world_example=1 have a higher probability of delta=1 than those with 0.
note: Presence (at least one comment) is used since no quantity was specified. OLS on binary delta gives a linear probability model; the association is not causal. Comments are current text; timing relative to the outcome is unknown and comments could include outcome-related text, which the prompt excludes as evidence.
